importance_detail.rationale: This bill requires federal agencies to report Other Transaction Agreements on USAspending.gov, establishes reporting and oversight frameworks involving inspectors general, and institutes transparency measures for federal spending.

card.summary: S. 4378, titled the "Protecting American Taxpayers Act," aims to combat fraud in federal programs, recover improper payments, return unspent COVID-19 and pandemic relief funds for deficit reduction, increase transparency in federal spending, and restrict certain foreign assistance.
